title: Jawahar Mal Appeals to the Khalsa Against Abdali

blocks.text: The page answers the question raised at the end of the previous episode by linking Delhi's danger to Najib Rohilla's maneuvering and Abdali's renewed pressure. In that emergency Jawahar Mal decides to send his representatives to the Khalsa Panth so that the Sikhs may be brought openly into the struggle.

The appeal stresses affinity as well as strategy. The envoys argue that the Jats and the Khalsa shared the same caste and the same occupation as defenders of their land, and that this is therefore the right moment to defend their faith against a devastator who threatens the whole region.

Jawahar Mal also offers practical support instead of empty rhetoric. He promises plenty of ammunition and arms, abundant provisions, and an alliance that would uphold India's honour if the Singhs agree to stand with him against Abdali and Rohilla power.
